'''Vurrha Chur''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and the leader of a criminal group known as [[Vurrha's Blood]].

==Biography==
Born on [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] to lower class parents, Vurrah Chur eventually found his way to the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Over the years, he worked as muscle for local law enforcement agencies on the planet before gradually accumulating a strong [[Vurrha's Blood|force]] of his own, becoming a small crime lord in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="UA" />

==Personality and traits==
Vurrha was a strong individual, working his way up the ranks on the tough planet of Tatooine. As he accumulated greater power in the Mos Eisley underworld, he developed a set of ambitions for himself and his crime syndicate, including wealth, power, and becoming well-aged.<ref name="UA" />
